hyperedges.label: Tailwind v3 to v4 Migration Rules

nodes.label: Consistency First Principle
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Follow existing codebase patterns; inconsistency is worse than a suboptimal pattern. Rules are defaults, not overrides.

nodes.label: Architecture Testing (arch())
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Enforce code conventions: controller suffix, models extend Eloquent Model, no debug helpers.

nodes.label: Pest Datasets
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Avoid repetitive tests such as validation rules.

nodes.label: Dark Mode (dark: variant)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: New pages must match existing dark mode support for consistency.

nodes.label: Test Organization (tests/Feature, tests/Unit)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Tests are core application code; do not remove without approval. Cover happy, failure and edge paths.

nodes.label: CSS-First Configuration (@theme)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: v4 replaces tailwind.config.js with the @theme directive in CSS.

nodes.label: Gap Utilities for Sibling Spacing
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Prefer gap over margins between siblings.

nodes.label: retry_after Greater Than timeout
nodes.rationale: Prevents duplicate job execution

nodes.label: Rate Limiting Auth and API Routes
nodes.norm_label: rate limiting auth and api routes

nodes.label: No Queries in Blade
nodes.rationale: Keep data loading out of views

nodes.label: ShouldDispatchAfterCommit
nodes.rationale: Avoid dispatching events for rolled-back transactions

nodes.label: No Inline JS CSS in Blade
nodes.norm_label: no inline js css in blade

nodes.label: Cache add
nodes.rationale: Atomic conditional writes

nodes.label: Cache flexible
nodes.rationale: Stale-while-revalidate for high-traffic data

nodes.label: validated Method
nodes.rationale: Only use validated data to avoid mass-assignment of unvalidated input

nodes.label: env Only in Config Files
nodes.rationale: env() returns null once config is cached

nodes.label: Laravel Core Features (routing, DI container, Eloquent, migrations, queues, broadcasting)
nodes.norm_label: laravel core features (routing, di container, eloquent, migrations, queues, broadcasting)

nodes.label: addSelect Subqueries
nodes.rationale: Fetch single value from has-many without eager-loading whole relation

nodes.label: Conditional Aggregates
nodes.rationale: CASE WHEN in selectRaw replaces multiple count queries

nodes.label: Correlated Subqueries for Ordering
nodes.rationale: Avoid joins for has-many sorting

nodes.label: Two Simple Queries Over One Complex
nodes.norm_label: two simple queries over one complex

nodes.label: whereIn plus pluck over whereHas
nodes.rationale: Better index usage

nodes.label: Chunking Large Datasets
nodes.rationale: chunk()/chunkById() bound memory usage

nodes.label: cursor Iteration
nodes.rationale: Memory-efficient read-only iteration

nodes.label: Database Indexes
nodes.rationale: Index columns used in WHERE, ORDER BY, JOIN

nodes.label: Eager Loading
nodes.rationale: Use with() to prevent N+1 queries

nodes.label: preventLazyLoading
nodes.rationale: Surface N+1 issues in development

nodes.label: withCount
nodes.rationale: Count relations without loading them
